title: Model Governance Provider Evidence Register Contract
description: Machine-checkable contract for the LLM-05 provider evidence register (PR-A Lane A2). Every entry records repository-only evidence status slots (region, retention, subprocessors, endpoints, DPA, residency, approval) for current providers (anthropic, sarvam, silero, livekit, supabase) and optional-comparison providers (gemini, deepseek). Allowed statuses are PENDING and OWNER_VERIFY only: no endpoint, residency, or DPA approval exists in repository-only work. Endpoint placeholders are closed uppercase tokens; real endpoints are never stored here. Latency is not residency: numeric latency-like status values are rejected. Approval statuses are closed to PENDING and OWNER_VERIFY only: the repository status validator and register validator reject any APPROVED/DEPLOYED/ACCEPTED/winner approval claim unconditionally — no EV-xxxx/UUID/ownerEvidenceRefs string can authorize it, because repository-only work carries no authentic external evidence.

entry.description: One provider evidence entry. All seven evidence status slots are closed to repository-only states (PENDING or OWNER_VERIFY); approval claims are rejected unconditionally with no evidence-reference escape. endpointPlaceholder, when present, is a closed uppercase token (never a URL, path, or credential).

registerDocument.description: The full register: a versioned document carrying at least the five current providers and the two optional-comparison providers.
